paper_title: Constraints on photon mass and dark photon from the Jovian magnetic field
notes: Constraint on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mX from Juno Jovian magnetic field data (Fig 7, 95% credible). Bound is independent of dark photon relic density (NOT a DM haloscope), so no local DM density assumed. Strongest bound epsilon<=2.8e-3 at mX=2.0e-15 eV; at epsilon=1 the excluded window is 3.2e-18<=mX<=3.2e-14 eV. Data points read from text (V-shaped exclusion, upper limit on epsilon); the full curve is in Fig 7 which is not numerically tabulated. Also derives photon mass limit m_gamma<2.5e-18 eV (not encoded here). Convention epsilon = tan(kappi) equals kinetic mixing chi. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.72, 4))
